lines.latin: Osorkhonai millii bostonii Tojikiston (National Museum of Antiquities of Tajikistan)

lines.text: NATIONAL MUSEUM OF ANTIQUITIES OF TAJIKISTAN

c41727195.notes: Trilingual metal lettering on blue bands above the three arches, Dushanbe (Russian left, Tajik centre, English right), each name over four short rows. Tajik uses Ҷ (U+04B6) in ТОҶИКИСТОН. In the English, 'of' is lowercase-styled in small letters before ANTIQUITIES and TAJIKISTAN. The small free-standing board at the lower left (Museum of ethnography) is a distractor; scaffolding at left.

c157004886.notes: Green letters on a curved canopy over the head office entrance of Amonatbonk, Dushanbe, shot upward so the letter row arcs; logo above. A small yellow notice by the door is a distractor; the guard is incidental.

lines.latin: viloyati Sughd (Historical Museum of Sughd Region)

c64327916.notes: Metal letters on the brick gate tower of the museum in the Khujand fortress. Stylised serif type: the Ъ in ТАЪРИХИИ has a small left flag and can be misread as Б, Л in ВИЛОЯТИ is drawn like Λ, СУҒД uses Ғ (U+0492). Three visitors pose in the doorway below (incidental). Small house-number plate '59' at right of the door (street name too small) and a framed notice at left are distractors.

lines.latin: privetstvuyut vas! (The people of Gorno-Badakhshan welcome you!)

c20915841.notes: Regional welcome sign at Kyzylart Pass on the Kyrgyz border: big black block letters ГБАО on a white pylon with two round emblems, and a rail panel with spaced letters. 'Н А Р О Д' is letter-spaced. The yurt-shaped shelter at right has no text.

c95501880.notes: End-of-settlement sign with a red diagonal bar crossing both lines (white panel, black letters), roadside near Dushanbe, at mid-distance.
